## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`)

- [ ] `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` are clean in `core/`

- [ ] New settings, models or protocol methods are documented
